## Lite

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-09-L1** /health answers liveness; /ready checks the database, queue and critical dependencies. | auto | `probe_log` |
| **SM-09-L2** Logs are JSON with a request or job ID and contain no secrets or personal data; errors reach monitoring. | auto + review | `sample_log` |

## Full

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-09-F1** Deploy N, then N+1 with a migration, then roll back to N on preview; the app stays healthy. | auto | `deploy_log` |
